flags.title: All three estimate amounts are client-provided and cannot be verified from an official source
flags.detail: The amounts $614 (Expert Plumbing Solutions), $550 (Bay Area Plumbing), and $135 (Fast Response) exist only in the client's brief. No official public source publishes them, so per this project's verification rules the amounts are labeled client-provided and are not presented as verified. The companies' identities, licenses, addresses, and phone numbers behind each quote ARE verified against the CSLB.
flags.action: Treat amounts as planning inputs only; request itemized written quotes before hiring.
flags.source_label: The CSLB license records that WERE verified for the companies behind these quotes

flags.title: The three quotes describe different scopes and are not directly comparable
flags.detail: $135 is for repair/adjustment of the plunger handle (trim/linkage work from above). $550 is for replacing the trip lever and spout with diverter (trim replacement). $614 is for replacing the complete waste-and-overflow assembly. Given the stated on-site condition - the trip lever is stuck inside hidden plumbing and removal from above has failed for 5+ licensed plumbers (client-stated, not independently verifiable) - the lower-priced approaches may not apply to the actual required work.
flags.action: Confirm the required scope (adjust vs. trim replacement vs. full waste-and-overflow replacement, plus any access opening) with each bidder before comparing prices.
flags.source_label: What a full waste-and-overflow replacement physically involves (manufacturer instructions)

flags.title: Estimate dating is ambiguous
flags.detail: The brief's date heading '8/30/26' appears once, above the first estimate only. Whether it applies to all three estimates is not stated.
flags.action: Client to confirm the date each estimate was issued.
flags.source_label: CSLB record of the company whose quote carries the 8/30/26 heading (identity verified; the date itself is client-provided)

flags.title: Shorthand company names were matched to specific CSLB-registered entities
flags.detail: The brief names 'Expert plumbing solutions', 'Bay Area plumbing', and 'Fast response'. Each was matched to a San Francisco company by name plus exact address/phone/license agreement with official records: Expert Plumbing Solutions (CSLB 977638, 1465 44th Ave, (415) 531-5340), Bay Area Plumbing (CSLB 757796, 335 14th Ave, (415) 668-8000), Fast Response Plumbing & Rooter (CSLB 1024971, Joseph Tinsley dba, San Francisco, C-36). Similar names exist in the Bay Area, so misidentification is possible.
flags.action: Client to confirm the quoting entities match these verified companies (e.g., against the written quote documents).
flags.source_label: Search the CSLB license database (the basis of each name-to-entity match)

flags.title: Bay Area Plumbing CSLB record shows a workers' compensation exemption
flags.detail: The CSLB record for license 757796 states the license 'is exempt from having workers compensation insurance; they certified that they have no employees at this time' (effective 12/11/2024). This is lawful for a sole owner with no employees, but it means the CSLB page shows no workers' compensation policy on file for this licensee.
flags.action: Request a current certificate of liability insurance (and note that if workers are used on the job, workers' compensation coverage is required).
flags.source_label: CSLB license 757796 record showing the exemption

flags.title: BBB page shows a stale license expiration date for Expert Plumbing Solutions
flags.detail: The BBB profile states license 977638 'expiration date of this license is 10/31/2026', while the CSLB (the licensing authority) shows expiration 10/31/2028 with current-and-active status as of 2026-11-06. The CSLB record governs; the BBB field appears stale.
flags.action: Rely on the CSLB license-detail page for license status.
flags.source_label: The BBB profile showing the conflicting date (CSLB governs)

flags.title: Aggregator profiles mix licenses between same-named companies
flags.detail: A BuildZoom profile titled 'Bay Area Plumbing' lists 13 license numbers, several of which belong to other entities on inspection (e.g., 1075566 resolves on CSLB to BAY AREA PIPE & EQUIPMENT INC dba BAY AREA MECHANICAL, 1320 Underwood Ave). Third-party aggregator data is a misattribution hazard for common company names.
flags.action: Only records read directly from the CSLB license-detail page and matching the company's own address and phone were used in this project.
flags.source_label: CSLB record proving license 1075566 belongs to Bay Area Pipe & Equipment dba Bay Area Mechanical, not the storefront Bay Area Plumbing

flags.title: Genteel Plumbers has two Yelp listing pages with different review counts
flags.detail: yelp.com/biz/genteel-plumbers-san-francisco-7 shows 4.7 (519 reviews); genteel-plumbers-san-francisco-8 shows 4.6 (17 reviews). Both carry the genteelplumbers.com website. Duplicate listings inflate/fragment review counts.
flags.action: Read reviews on both pages; treat counts as indicative only.
flags.source_label: The second (duplicate) Genteel Plumbers Yelp listing

flags.title: Two different 'Discount Plumbing' entities operate in the area
flags.detail: Discount Plumbing Rooter Services LLC (CSLB 1140843, Burlingame HQ, San Francisco storefront) is the company with the plumbinginsf.com site and the 4321 24th St San Francisco Yelp listing. A separate BBB-listed 'Discount Plumbing, Inc.' (BBB records license 1144424, started 1989, Burlingame) is a distinct business.
flags.action: Verify which entity any quote comes from.
flags.source_label: BBB profile of the separate 'Discount Plumbing, Inc.' entity
